messages:
Anya: Quick standup — VaultForge wants a coordinated cross-cloud marketplace bundle (AWS + GCP), SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and HSM/KMS keybinding. 10-min sync?
Sam: On in 6. Main blockers?
Priya: Legal embargo window, attestation format, and cert rotation automation.
Derek: Partner asked for our SCIM schema + group handling. I can draft mapping now and send.
Kevin: Marketing: need 2 console screenshots (purchase flow + key bind), a 40-60 word partner blurb, and the embargo timing. Who signs PR off?
VaultForge (partner-bot): Partner uploaded attestation + keywrap spec: https://partners.vaultforge.example/artifacts/attest-keywrap-v1.json
Legal: Please share contract link and proposed embargo dates. I can review fallback language but need the contract to confirm obligations.
Anya: Proposing internal freeze Fri 18:00 PT, public lift Mon 09:00 PT. Thoughts?
Kevin: That gives marketing time — 👍 from me.
Sam: SAML metadata: use prod SP URL but set assertionConsumerService index=1 for QA fallback. I'll push metadata XML to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/ssometa/vaultforge.xml
Derek: SCIM mapping (draft):
```
externalId -> user.external_id
userName -> user.email
name.givenName -> user.first_name
name.familyName -> user.last_name
active -> user.active
groups -> user.groups
```
Sending this to VaultForge with note that phone/address are optional attributes.
Priya: Ops/QA smoke list we need captured: IdP-initiated SAML login, SP-initiated logout, SCIM full sync (sample 200 users), HSM keywrap/unwrap + attestation verification, marketplace purchase -> bind flow, and perf burst at 100TPS for 5m.
Sam: I'll add that to the playbook checklist. Also note: ensure ACS URLs are reachable from partner VPN during tests.
Derek: Runbook snippet for oncall cert rotation / HSM handling:
```
1) curl -sS https://secrets.redwood/internal/vaultforge/attest.json -o /tmp/vf_attest.json
2) ./ops/hsm_wrap --partner vaultforge --rotate --dry-run
3) post run-id and logs to #eng-oncall and tag oncall lead
```
Priya: Fallback behavior: runtime prefers partner HSM/KMS; if unreachable, fall back to locally-wrapped master key stored in our secure store. Legal: we should avoid wording that implies an SLA on partner KMS. Proposed marketing-safe phrase: "Automatic KMS failover to locally-wrapped keys to maintain availability."
Legal: I'll adjust phrasing to be contract-safe and confirm by EOD tomorrow. Need contract link to check liabilities.
Kevin: I'll draft the marketplace blurb including the failover sentence and produce screenshots by Fri EOD. Will share drafts here for quick review.
VaultForge (partner-bot): Partner confirms they can deliver HSM attestation and keywrap test vectors by Wed AM. They also confirm marketing asset visibility window is acceptable.
Anya: Owners: Sam (SAML metadata + ops checklist), Derek (SCIM mapping + runbook), Priya (technical doc + fallback wording), Kevin (marketing + PR), Legal (contract review). I'll assemble the playbook doc and post the link when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: Uploading metadata to drive now.
Kevin: I'll start the screenshot captures on the staging console and share links when done.
_notes: Coordination thread for joint marketplace + security/identity partner integration (SSO/SAML, SCIM, KMS/HSM).
